title: explorer's thread list wants the st list columns, and they need WP-17's row type
body:
hv asked for `Status | Created | Completed` on the explorer's thread list alongside the open/closed seam, matching what `intent st list` prints. The seam landed at `3f037021`; the columns did not, and hv ruled they ride with WP-17.

**WHY THEY DO NOT FIT TODAY.** `tui::layout::Row` carries one `title` and one `value` -- one display pair. `ID | Title | Status | Created | Completed` is five columns, so the row type has to grow a cell vector, or the extra three get packed into `value` as one preformatted string. Packing is cheaper and worse: `plan()` aligns on a single value column, and `tui/views.rs` already warns in its own header that one aligned column cannot serve two very different value shapes.

**AND THE PLACEMENT MATTERS MORE THAN THE WIDTH.** The collection arm at `render.rs` is the ONE view that does not go through `intentsvcs::form::triples`. Item views go through the shared derivation specifically so the terminal and web faces agree by construction -- `tui/views.rs`: *building the TUI's rows any other way would make the two faces agree only by coincidence, which is what `AC-17.1` exists to refuse*. A hand-kept column set in that match arm gives the terminal columns the web face has no way to learn about. `ST_COLUMNS` in `render.rs` is already a third home for the same five names.

**SO THE WORK IS: declare the collection column set beside `form::triples` and widen `Row` to carry cells** -- both of which WP-17 is already opening up. Doing it in the TUI arm first would book exactly the divergence hv said they did not want.

**NOT DIVERGING IN THE MEANTIME.** Ordering and the seam are shared today: `index_order` sorts open-before-closed and `views::open_run` names the boundary, both in `intentsvcs`, so the web realiser places the seam identically without reading any TUI code.

**ONE MORE THING THE TWO FACES DISAGREE ON, AND IT IS OLDER THAN THIS.** `intent st list` defaults to WIP only -- *showing 1 of 10 threads, status `WIP`* -- while explorer shows every thread. Raised with hv 2026-09-03 and deliberately left alone: a list you scroll wants everything, a line you read wants the live ones. Recorded so the next person meets it as a decision rather than as a bug.
